item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29245

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
📍
The Sever Group of Forces improved its tactical situation.
Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one airmobile brigade of the AFU, and one territorial defence brigade close to Yastrebinoye, Khoten, Radkovka, and Volnaya Sloboda (Sumy region).
💥
In Kharkov region
, strikes were delivered at formations of one mechanised brigade, two assault regiments of the AFU, three territorial defence brigades, and national guard brigades close to Grigorovka, Tsupovka, Prikolotnoye, Novouzhvinovka, Svetlichnoye, and Borshchevaya (Kharkov region).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 200 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, three motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station.
📍
The Zapad Group's units took more advantageous lines and positions.
Russian elements inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, one assault brigade of the AFU, one marine brigade, and one territorial defence brigade near Berezovka, Staroverovka, Chervony Oskol (Kharkov region), Raygorodok, and Mayaki (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy losses amounted to up to 190 troops, one Kazak armoured fighting vehicle, one U.S.-made HMMWV armoured vehicle, 16 motor vehicles, two artillery guns, and one electronic warfare station.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation along the front line.
Formations of three mechanised brigades, two airmobile brigades, one mountain assault brigade, and one assault regiment of the AFU have been hit near Kramatorsk, Nikolayevka, Slavyansk, Semenovka, Klinovoye, Kondratovka, and Druzhkovka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 145 troops, one Novator armoured fighting vehicle, 20 motor vehicles, and two field artillery guns.
📍
The Tsentr Group of Forces improved the tactical situation.
The Group's units inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of five mechanised brigades, one assault regiment of the AFU, two marine brigades, three national guard brigades, and the Azov Special Operations Brigade close to Novoandreyevka, Novotroitskoye, Ivanovka (Dnepropetrovsk region), Novovodyanoye, Verovka, Andreyevka, and Dobropolye (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 405 troops, two Kazak armoured fighting vehicles, nine motor vehicles, and one 122-mm D-30 howitzer.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

↗️
The Vostok Group's units advanced to the depth of the enemy's defence.
Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of two assault brigades, three air assault brigades, two assault regiments of the AFU, and one marine brigade close to Shevyakino, Prosyanaya (Dnepropetrovsk region), Vasinovka, Timoshevka, Nikolskoye, and Chervony Yar (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 325 troops, one armoured personnel carrier, three armoured fighting vehicles, and six motor vehicles.
💥
Units of the Dnepr Group of Forces inflicted losses
on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one mountain assault brigade, and one assault regiment of the AFU, and one marine brigade near Kamyshevakha, Malokaterinovka, Antonovka, Dimitrovo, Grigorovka, Novoyakovlevka, and Orekhov (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
Up to 50 troops, 22 motor vehicles, three electronic warfare stations, and one electronic reconnaissance station were neutralised.
✈️
Operational-Tactical Aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation have inflicted damage
on the Ukrainian transport and logistics infrastructure used by the AFU, assembly and storage areas of unmanned aerial vehicles and their components, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in the 144 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
four guided aerial bombs and 400 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.

▫️

field artillery guns and mortars,
▫️

item.description: 📆 Top News Today ❗️ The President of Russia, in his capacity as the Supreme Commander-in-Chief, ordered Russian forces to cease attacks on Kiev for three days starting at midnight today, due to the talks — and preparations thereof — with American negotiators to be held in Kiev. 🚩 Exploiting success: the Yuzhnaya Group's units liberated the settlement of Kurtovka of the Donetsk People's Republic. 💥 Thwarting the enemy's plans: the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out a group strike using high‑precision ground‑based weapons and long‑range attack unmanned aerial vehicles against metallurgical plants that supply military defence enterprises, as well as logistics centres and power substations. 🎮 Gerans' inspection : hit an enemy drone production plant , a logistics centre , radar stations , and vessels , used in the interests of the AFU. 🔥 Aviation says 'hello' : thee Russian Aerospace Forces crews hit UAV command posts of the AFU. 🤝 Your courage will live for ages : Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation/Chief of the Main Military and Political Directorate of the Russian Armed Forces, General of the Army Viktor Goremykin presented awards to participants of the special military operation undergoing treatment and rehabilitation, as well as medical personnel of the military hospital in Volgograd. #TopNews 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
